_: Region sheet for imperial-fringe (2.5a1b). Talk is seeded from the region's published place records; every trait cites a lore dossier or says inferred.

norms.text: Imperial-descended families and lukiul Argonians share the villages and keep separate wells and landings.
Written records still settle things here; Gideon's courthouse is the last working one.
The roads close in monsoon season and everyone plans the year around it.
Legion descendants keep old ranks and drills without pay.

taboos.text: Calling a lukiul Argonian a traitor to the trees.
Defending what the An-Xileel did in 4E 48; their weapon killed Gideon's majority.

values.text: A clear title and a signed paper.
A stone building over a reed one, among the Imperial families.
Getting the harvest to Leyawiin before the road shuts.

contempts.text: Nativists who call the assimilated lukiul.
The Sul-Xan and anyone who deals with them.

place.text: The frontier is hills, a bad road and orchards the swamp is taking back.

work.text: Bog iron, herbs, red-clay pots and the road trade, when the road is open.

people.text: A neighbour is Imperial or lukiul; both of them keep accounts.

faction.text: The Legion's heirs hold posts without pay.

hist.text: Most lukiul speak of the Hist politely and rarely visit one.

empire.text: The Empire built this country and then left it; some here still miss it.

trade.text: The Gideon–Leyawiin road is the only land trade in the province.

danger.text: Death hoppers, hackwings and fleshflies at the border posts; the Sul-Xan beyond them.

rumour.text: Talk is of the governor's purse and who will clear the deserters' camp.

directions.text: Ways are given by road, milestone and bridge, the Imperial way.

addressTerms.text: Citizen, sir and madam among the Imperial families; serjeant and the old ranks among the Legion heirs.
Argonians are called by name, not by category, in the towns.

neverSaid.text: That the Archein serfdoms were worse than what came after.
What the Legion did to the tribes before the withdrawal.

grievances.text: Gideon's governor will not pay to clear the camp at the Broke Column.
The Imperial-built well at Claywater is failing, but half the village will not help rebuild it in stone.

rumours.text: The diggers have abandoned the deep end of the bog-iron seep.
A Sul-Xan mask was found at a border post.

views.text: The interior folk think anyone who writes things down has lost their soul.
Blackrose is a day's ride and a different world; people go in and stay.
Shadowfen is a long way round. The Dunmer up there are not our business.
